infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Weav AI uses your camera for PhotoFit — an AI body scan that estimates your bust, waist, and hip measurements from a single full-body photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Weav AI lets you import an existing full-body photo for the PhotoFit body scanner instead of using the live camera.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Optional — not required by Weav AI. Listed because some WebView implementations request it alongside camera.
